title: Complete typed internal boundaries
ears: WHEN a validated external event enters an internal reducer, the controller SHALL carry domain-specific typed identities and outcomes through its resulting effect descriptions until wire encoding.

scenarios.name: Exact receipt
scenarios.given: a validated receipt for one request/incarnation
scenarios.then: only the exact transaction settles and wire encoding remains unchanged

scenarios.name: Foreign input
scenarios.then: no admitted event or mutation is produced and correlated refusal is retained

tradeoffs: Codec and call-site migration; phantom types do not authenticate senders; preserve wire bytes.

title: Preserve effects as an auditable dependency algebra
ears: WHEN a native effect depends on another effect's completion, the controller SHALL admit the dependent request only after the matching native committed receipt satisfies the recorded prerequisite.

scenarios.name: Pending prerequisite
scenarios.given: restore-before-activate dependency for an exact incarnation
scenarios.when: restore remains Pending then its exact committed receipt arrives
scenarios.then: activation waits then registered activation can proceed

scenarios.name: Wrong prerequisite
scenarios.given: a refused restore or foreign committed receipt
scenarios.then: it cannot satisfy the prerequisite and independent controls remain usable

tradeoffs: Explicit dependency metadata and replay oracle costs; retain independence; no new framework necessary.

title: Publish one conversation contract with local obligations
ears: WHEN a protocol participant receives a control message, the system SHALL validate its actor, exact conversation identity and permitted transition before producing authority or ownership effects.

scenarios.name: Unadopted refusal
scenarios.then: stable refusal proof preserves already-ordered cancellation proof

scenarios.name: Illegal retirement
scenarios.given: an adopted buffer or stale actor
scenarios.then: it cannot bypass drainage or retire current actor resource

tradeoffs: New verification artifact refining existing behavior; manual table maintenance; no static-session-typing claim.

title: Treat cancellation as a request followed by proved closure
ears: WHEN cancellation invalidates an owned operation, the native authority SHALL reject subsequent unauthorized publication and retain its ownership record until matching physical retirement proof permits final acknowledgement.

scenarios.name: Cancel refusal race
scenarios.then: ordered cancellation/refusal proofs leave no reservation after final ack

scenarios.name: Held reader
scenarios.given: adopted buffer with held GIO reader
scenarios.then: fetch revoked immediately and terminal release waits for producer completion and reader drainage

tradeoffs: Retained records and native callback coordination; release on cancel-send unsafe; generation-scoped drain avoids global waits.

title: Separate causal order, epoch identity and deadline time
ears: WHEN queueing, frontend replacement or reconciliation occurs, the authority SHALL preserve the operation's original native clock domain, time origin and deadline while validating ordered control delivery independently of observation revisions.

scenarios.name: Restart receipt
scenarios.then: original request reconciles without deadline renewal or mutation replay

scenarios.name: Gap clock
scenarios.given: control sequence gap or replaced clock domain
scenarios.then: new admission withheld until coherent reconciliation and invalid timing cannot authorize work

tradeoffs: Metadata and clock/queue instrumentation; frontend timers feedback only; vector clocks unnecessary.
